keys: THE ART OF A LITTLE LESS
en: THE ART OF A LITTLE LESS
ja: 少ない光で、深いひらめき。

keys: ○  DOT socket    1  shadow still needed    ●○  layers
en: ○  DOT socket    1  shadow still needed    ●○  layers
ja: ○ 点を置く場所    1 必要な影の数    ●○ 影の層
上からの光・影は下へ
下からの光・影は上へ
左からの光・影は右へ
右からの光・影は左へ
まず解く。それから、手数を磨く。
これ以上ない、一手ずつ。
解けました。次は、もっと短く。

keys: PAR %d · Every shot earned its place.
en: PAR %d · Every shot earned its place.
ja: 最短 %d 手。無駄のない光でした。

keys: Cleared in %d. Can you find the %d-shot solution?
en: Cleared in %d. Can you find the %d-shot solution?
ja: %d 手でクリア。最短の %d 手に挑んでみませんか。
02 / %sから照らす準備ができました

keys: Up to %d DOTs this shot. Tap a placed DOT to remove it.
en: Up to %d DOTs this shot. Tap a placed DOT to remove it.
ja: 一度に置ける点は %d 個まで。置いた点をタップすると外せます。

keys: Too much shadow. Coral cells show the excess. Undo and try another layer.
en: Too much shadow. Coral cells show the excess. Undo and try another layer.
ja: 赤いマスは影が多すぎます。一手戻して、重ね方を変えてみよう。

keys: That shadow stays. Place the next layer.
en: That shadow stays. Place the next layer.
ja: 今の影は残ります。次の影を重ねてみよう。

keys: One layer rewound. Try a different grouping or light.
en: One layer rewound. Try a different grouping or light.
ja: 一手戻しました。点の組み合わせや光の向きを変えてみよう。

keys: Progress could not be saved. You can keep playing this session.
en: Progress could not be saved. You can keep playing this session.
ja: 記録を保存できませんでした。このまま遊ぶことはできます。
音あり・タップで消音
消音中・タップで音を出す

keys: 20 small puzzles. Explore freely; every study remembers your layers.
en: 20 small puzzles. Explore freely; every study remembers your layers.
ja: 20問の小さなひらめき。好きな問題からどうぞ。途中の影も保存されます。
%d / 20 クリア    · クリア    * 最短

keys: Make every number reach zero. Take all the time you need.
en: Make every number reach zero. Take all the time you need.
ja: 影を重ねて、すべての数字をゼロに。時間制限はありません。

keys: Tap a ring to place a DOT. Tap it again to remove it.
en: Tap a ring to place a DOT. Tap it again to remove it.
ja: 輪をタップして点を置きます。もう一度タップすると外せます。

keys: Pick a light. Each DOT adds 1 shadow to every cell beyond it. Shadows stay between shots.
en: Pick a light. Each DOT adds 1 shadow to every cell beyond it. Shadows stay between shots.
ja: 光の向きを選びます。点の先に影が1つずつ伸び、放った後も影は残ります。

keys: DOT cells receive no shadow that shot, but rays continue through them. Grouping and splitting give different results.
en: DOT cells receive no shadow that shot, but rays continue through them. Grouping and splitting give different results.
ja: 点のあるマスには、その回の影がつきません。影はその先へ進みます。まとめて置くか、分けるかで結果が変わります。

keys: Any exact solution is a clear. PAR is the proven fewest shots. Undo is unlimited.
en: Any exact solution is a clear. PAR is the proven fewest shots. Undo is unlimited.
ja: 数字がすべてゼロならクリア。最短は検証済みの最小手数です。何度でも一手戻せます。

keys:
Art & audio: Kenney · CC0
No timer. No penalty for trying.
Keyboard: Tab / Enter · Ctrl+Z to undo
en:
Art & audio: Kenney · CC0
No timer. No penalty for trying.
Keyboard: Tab / Enter · Ctrl+Z to undo
ja:
素材・音：Kenney / CC0
時間制限も、試すことへのペナルティもなし。
Tab / Enter で操作・Ctrl+Z で一手戻す

keys: This clears the current layers. Your best result stays saved.
en: This clears the current layers. Your best result stays saved.
ja: 今の影を消して、最初から始めます。ベスト記録は残ります。

keys: Tap the ring to place a DOT. Light from above casts a shadow below it.
en: Tap the ring to place a DOT. Light from above casts a shadow below it.
ja: 輪をタップして点を置こう。上からの光で、点の下に影が伸びます。

keys: Choose where light enters. The arrow shows where the shadow travels.
en: Choose where light enters. The arrow shows where the shadow travels.
ja: 光の来る向きを選ぼう。矢印は影が伸びる向きです。

keys: Shadows stay after each shot. A 2 needs two layers of shadow.
en: Shadows stay after each shot. A 2 needs two layers of shadow.
ja: 影は次の手にも残ります。「2」には影を2つ重ねよう。

keys: Two sockets, one DOT per shot. Build one layer, then the next.
en: Two sockets, one DOT per shot. Build one layer, then the next.
ja: 置ける場所はふたつ。一度に置ける点はひとつ。順番に影を重ねよう。

keys: Light can travel down or across. Find a place for each shadow.
en: Light can travel down or across. Find a place for each shadow.
ja: 影は下にも、横にも伸びます。それぞれの影の始まりを探そう。

keys: You can now place two DOTs before casting. Can one shot do both jobs?
en: You can now place two DOTs before casting. Can one shot do both jobs?
ja: 今度は点を2つ置けます。一度の光で、ふたつの影を作れるかな。

keys: DOT cells receive no shadow this shot. Beyond them, shadows add up.
en: DOT cells receive no shadow this shot. Beyond them, shadows add up.
ja: 点のあるマスに、その回の影はつきません。その先では影が重なります。

keys: Same sockets, a different target. What changes if you split the shots?
en: Same sockets, a different target. What changes if you split the shots?
ja: 同じ場所でも、目標は別。光を分けて放つと、何が変わるかな。

keys: One DOT or two? Different layers may need different groupings.
en: One DOT or two? Different layers may need different groupings.
ja: 点はひとつ？ それともふたつ？ 影ごとに組み合わせを考えよう。

keys: Find a clear first. Then try to make the same shadows in fewer shots.
en: Find a clear first. Then try to make the same shadows in fewer shots.
ja: まずはクリアを目指そう。それから、同じ影をもっと少ない手数で。

keys: Read the empty spaces, too. A zero tells you where a shadow cannot fall.
en: Read the empty spaces, too. A zero tells you where a shadow cannot fall.
ja: 空白も手がかり。ゼロのマスには影を落とせません。

keys: Separate the target into simple layers. Which shadow belongs on its own?
en: Separate the target into simple layers. Which shadow belongs on its own?
ja: 目標を単純な影に分けてみよう。ひとつで作る影はどれだろう。

keys: An aligned pair can leave a quiet space between layers.
en: An aligned pair can leave a quiet space between layers.
ja: 並べたふたつの点で、影の中に静かな空白を残せます。

keys: A 3 is several shadows meeting. Find the pieces of the sum.
en: A 3 is several shadows meeting. Find the pieces of the sum.
ja: 「3」は影がいくつも出会う場所。その足し算をほどいてみよう。

keys: Familiar sockets, a new arrangement. Look again before casting.
en: Familiar sockets, a new arrangement. Look again before casting.
ja: 見覚えのある配置も、目標が変われば別の問題。もう一度よく見よう。

keys: All four lights are available. Arrows show the direction shadows travel.
en: All four lights are available. Arrows show the direction shadows travel.
ja: 四方から光を放てます。矢印は、影が伸びる向きです。

keys: Start with the cells that only one direction can reach.
en: Start with the cells that only one direction can reach.
ja: ひとつの向きからしか影を作れないマスを探そう。

keys: DOTs protect their cells while shadows continue beyond them.
en: DOTs protect their cells while shadows continue beyond them.
ja: 点は自分のマスを影から守ります。影は、その先へ進みます。

keys: Small layers build a complex whole. Take your time; Undo is unlimited.
en: Small layers build a complex whole. Take your time; Undo is unlimited.
ja: 複雑な影も、小さな重なりから。何度でも戻して、ゆっくり考えよう。

keys: Five by five. Everything you need is already in the rules.
en: Five by five. Everything you need is already in the rules.
ja: 5×5の盤面へ。必要なルールは、もうすべて知っています。
こちらから、あちらから
すべての道をたどって

keys: The empty cells are part of the pattern. Notice where a shadow must not land.
en: The empty cells are part of the pattern. Notice where a shadow must not land.
ja: 空白も目標の一部です。影を落としてはいけない場所に注目しよう。

keys: Trace the required totals along their rows and columns. Which directions can reach each one?
en: Trace the required totals along their rows and columns. Which directions can reach each one?
ja: 目標の数字から行と列をたどろう。それぞれのマスへ届く向きは？

keys: Compare putting the dots together with splitting them across shots. The zero-holes change.
en: Compare putting the dots together with splitting them across shots. The zero-holes change.
ja: 点を一緒に置く場合と、手を分ける場合を比べよう。ゼロの場所が変わります。

keys: The arrow shows shadow travel. Work back from the target to the edge light.
en: The arrow shows shadow travel. Work back from the target to the edge light.
ja: 矢印は影が伸びる向きです。目標から盤面の縁へさかのぼろう。

keys: Start with a number that has few possible incoming rays. Let it narrow the choices.
en: Start with a number that has few possible incoming rays. Let it narrow the choices.
ja: 届く光が限られる数字を見つけよう。それが他の選択をしぼります。

keys: Scan the five-by-five pattern before firing. A distant cell can rule out a direction.
en: Scan the five-by-five pattern before firing. A distant cell can rule out a direction.
ja: 放つ前に5×5の模様を見渡そう。離れたマスが向きを決める手がかりです。

keys: Work backwards from the most constrained cells. Every shot still follows the same simple rules.
en: Work backwards from the most constrained cells. Every shot still follows the same simple rules.
ja: 選択肢の少ないマスから逆向きに考えよう。ルールはいつも同じです。

keys: Bring the whole toolkit together: direction, grouping, empty cells and persistent layers.
en: Bring the whole toolkit together: direction, grouping, empty cells and persistent layers.
ja: 学んだ考え方を重ねよう。光の向き、点の組、空白、残る影がすべて手がかりです。
%d / 100 クリア    · クリア    * 最短

keys: Every DOT casts its own shadow. DOTs in the same line overlap, so one shot can add 2 to a cell. The dots under each cell count its layers.
en: Every DOT casts its own shadow. DOTs in the same line overlap, so one shot can add 2 to a cell. The dots under each cell count its layers.
ja: 点はひとつずつ自分の影を落とします。同じ線上に並んだ点の影は重なるので、1回の光でも2つ増えるマスがあります。マスの下の小さな丸が影の層の数です。

keys: Shadows overlapped: one shot added +%d to a cell. DOTs in a line each cast their own shadow.
en: Shadows overlapped: one shot added +%d to a cell. DOTs in a line each cast their own shadow.
ja: 影が重なりました。1回の光で +%d のマスがあります。並んだ点は、それぞれ自分の影を落とします。
